_comment: Whole hand-written attestations (the user wrote each sentence out in full). slice_paragraphs.py cuts each box out of its photo (after rotating it upright by 'rotate' degrees counter-clockwise) into private/handwriting/paragraphs/. compose() uses a paragraph instead of assembling words when the attestation text matches 'text' exactly. Add more samples of the same text for variety: one is picked per voucher.

paragraphs.text: প্রত্যয়ন করা যাইতেছে যে, ইন্টারনেট সংযোগ মেরামত কাজে উল্লেখিত অর্থ যথাযথভাবে ব্যয়িত হয়েছে।
